notes: I replaced the empty model with a two-component Gaussian hypothesis: a narrow positive bump near x=0 (to match the 0.0362 at x=2.9) minus a broad shallow negative component (to match the ~-0.003 values at |x|≈50–60 and near-zero elsewhere).
